title: Deploy fan-out: migrate.js tenants, then the report to the platform
caption: packages/db/src/migrate/tenants.ts; deploy/scripts/deploy.sh section 2; ota/backend/src/provisioning/report-migrations.command.ts. The runner never writes platform.tenant_schema_migrations itself.

steps.label: SELECT schema_name FROM platform.tenants WHERE status IN ('provisioning','active','suspended') ORDER BY key
per schema (≤ 4 at once): BEGIN; SET LOCAL ROLE velexis_provisioner; pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext(schema)); set_config search_path; pending files + ledger rows; COMMIT
steps.note: Provisioning tenant without schema → skipped; active/suspended without schema → failed.

steps.label: report {target, total, applied[], failed[], skipped[]} (mode 0600); exit 3 when failed/total > 0.1
switch release only after both succeeded
